Anya: Quick brain-dump: we need a proposal to support partial streaming responses with safe retries. Today the gateway either buffers the entire stream for a retry or fails midstream. Looking for tradeoffs and an actionable plan.

Jonathan: Two axes: memory footprint vs client-visible resume/idempotency. Options: chunk-level ACKs, resume tokens, server-side checkpoints. cc @Kevin.

Kevin: Chunk ACKs cut server bookkeeping (track last-acked chunk) but change protocol. Resume tokens push complexity to token issuance/validation and need GC, TTL, replay protection. Stateful KV vs signed stateless token tradeoffs.

Maria: Stateless tokens can be compact and include model provenance+offset+sig. Avoids KV but won't capture ephemeral runtime state like kv-cache.

Dave: Right 1 stateless tokens can't encode attention/kvcache snapshots. Resuming may need that state or force restart from scratch which affects output.

Anya: Hybrid proposal: short-lived ring buffer on edge (N seconds / M KB). Issue resume tokens valid for that window. Token use after expiry falls back to a restart path (explicitly billed & signaled). Most transient network issues covered cheaply.

Jonathan: Backpressure plan: per-connection memory budget + admission control. If budget exceeded, convert session to checkpoint-only mode (persist minimal resume data) and drop live buffer; else respond 429 or tear down per SLO.

Kevin: Prototype headers/examples:

```
# Resume
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-Resume-Token: <b64-signed>" \
     -H "X-Partial-Offset: 3456" \
     https://edge.redwood.ai/v1/streams/resume

# Server indicates window
HTTP/1.1 206 Partial Content
X-Stream-Window: 30s
```

Maria: Retry semantics: idempotent vs non-idempotent. For tool-calls/side effects block retries unless client supplies compensation. Add `X-Idempotent: true|false` header; default false for tool-enabled chats.

Anya: Telemetry: emit token-issued, token-resumed, token-expired, buffer-evicted. Optimize can suggest defaults per workload.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: edge-resume-proto-v1 -> staging (build #4321) :shipit:

Dave: Tests: memory-pressure (thousands slow clients), resume abuse (token replay cross-tenant), resume-after-variant-change (model mismatch), perf 95/99p. Validate billing attribution on restart path.

Jonathan: I'll draft RFC skeleton with perf goals & API contract. Ownership: @Maria token format/security; @Kevin edge limits/admission.

Maria: Will draft token format + security analysis and PoC verifier; posting in ~48h.

Anya: Open Q: if resume token points to incompatible/removed model variant, respond 409 with hint to client to restart, or best-effort resume on nearest variant? I vote 409 + hint.

Kevin: Agree 409-by-default. Best-effort risky.

Anya: I'll capture requirements + checklist for RFC. Thanks!
